title: SG-4 input: one per-frame cue record (JSON Lines, one object per line)
description: STATUS: V1-PROPOSED (awaiting SG-1/SG-2/SG-3 confirmation; see documentation/interface_tracking.md). Producer: SG-1 (face, clock), SG-2 (eye), SG-3 (mouth, head). Consumer: SG-4. Any cue block may be null when unavailable. A null block, a null value, or confidence below the SG-4 threshold makes that cue INVALID for the frame: it never counts as closed or yawning. Out-of-order and duplicate timestamps are dropped by SG-4 and counted; gaps > 200 ms are logged. SG-4 also accepts SG-2's native eye record via module_4/src/sg4/adapters.py.

frame_id.description: SG-1 frame counter. Not used for timing.

timestamp_ms.description: SG-1 monotonic capture clock in milliseconds. Never wall-clock, never frame_id x 33 ms. All SG-4 durations come from this field.

closure_prob.description: 0 = fully open, 1 = fully closed. If null, SG-4 maps state closed -> 1.0, open -> 0.0, unknown -> invalid.

yawn_prob.description: Per-frame probability the mouth is in a yawn. SG-4 forms debounced yawn EVENTS from it.

pitch_deg.description: Degrees. SIGN CONVENTION: negative = head down (chin towards chest), 0 = facing camera, positive = head up.

yaw_deg.description: Degrees, positive = driver turns to their left (reference only).
